entries.title: React Three Fiber & Three.js Setup
entries.why: React Three Fiber (R3F) is a React renderer for Three.js, enabling declarative 3D scene composition. Instead of imperative Three.js code, we write JSX components that become 3D objects.
entries.whatItDoes: Imports: Suspense (async loading), Canvas (R3F's root component), Loader/Preload (asset management from drei), THREE namespace for WebGL constants, and local components for scene, effects, HUD, and socket connection.

entries.title: Main App Component
entries.why: The App component is the root of the 3D digital twin. It orchestrates the Canvas (WebGL), scene content, effects, UI overlays, and WebSocket connection initialization.
entries.whatItDoes: 1) Calls useSocket() to establish real-time connection, 2) Renders full-screen div with Canvas, 3) Configures WebGL: shadows, antialiasing, ACES tone mapping, high-performance mode, 4) Sets camera: 65° FOV, near=0.1, far=500, positioned at (0, 2, 15), 5) Wraps scene in Suspense for async loading.

failureModes.behavior: Canvas fails to render, blank screen
failureModes.recovery: Show fallback message for unsupported browsers

entries.perfNotes: dpr={[1, 2]} limits pixel ratio to 2x max, preventing GPU overload on Retina displays

entries.title: WebGL Canvas Configuration
entries.why: Three.js WebGL configuration affects visual quality and performance. These settings balance realism (shadows, tone mapping) with performance (high-performance preference).
entries.whatItDoes: gl prop configures WebGLRenderer: antialias=true (smooth edges), ACESFilmicToneMapping (cinematic color), SRGBColorSpace (correct color output), powerPreference='high-performance' (prefer discrete GPU). onCreated callback enables soft PCF shadow maps.
entries.perfNotes: PCFSoftShadowMap is more expensive than BasicShadowMap but looks much better

entries.title: Scene Content with Suspense
entries.why: 3D assets (models, textures) load asynchronously. Suspense shows a loading fallback while assets load, preventing a blank screen or partially-loaded scene.
entries.whatItDoes: Wraps FactoryScene and Effects in Suspense with LoadingFallback. Preload component tells drei to preload all assets upfront. Effects is currently commented out for debugging.

failureModes.recovery: Check network tab, verify asset URLs

entries.perfNotes: Preload all reduces runtime loading stutters

entries.title: Loading Progress Bar (drei Loader)
entries.why: Users need feedback during asset loading. The drei Loader shows a styled progress bar that matches the digital twin's cyberpunk aesthetic.
entries.whatItDoes: Configures Loader component with custom styles: dark background (#0a0a0a), cyan accent (#00ffff), JetBrains Mono font. dataInterpolation formats the percentage as 'LOADING DIGITAL TWIN... XX%'.

entries.title: 3D Loading Fallback Component
entries.why: When assets are loading, showing nothing is jarring. A simple wireframe cube gives visual feedback that the 3D context is working while actual content loads.
entries.whatItDoes: Renders minimal scene: ambient light at 10% intensity, centered wireframe box (2x2x2 units) in cyan color. This appears inside the Canvas during Suspense loading.
entries.perfNotes: Wireframe is very cheap to render

entries.title: Pointer Lock Overlay
entries.why: FPS-style mouse look requires pointer lock (hiding cursor, getting raw mouse movement). Browsers require a user gesture (click) to enable pointer lock for security reasons.
entries.whatItDoes: 1) Shows fullscreen overlay with 'CLICK TO ENTER' prompt, 2) On click, calls document.body.requestPointerLock(), 3) Listens for pointerlockchange to hide overlay when locked, 4) Shows controls hint (WASD/Mouse).

failureModes.behavior: Overlay stays visible, user can't look around
failureModes.recovery: User must grant permission or use different browser

entries.securityNotes: Pointer lock is security-sensitive - only works after user gesture
